subject: New connector for HR system
body: Looking to connect our HR system as a new data source - wanted to check supported formats before we start the setup.

subject: Export missing a column

subject: Dashboard sharing with external partner

subject: Alert recipient list question
body: Want to add two more people to an existing alert's recipient list - can we do that ourselves or does support need to change it?

subject: Year-end export customization
body: Need a custom export layout for year-end reporting with a few extra summary rows. Understand this takes longer to configure properly, just flagging it early.

subject: New data source for Q4 close
body: We're adding a new data source (our updated ERP module) ahead of Q4 close and need to set up a connector for it. Could you send the standard onboarding steps, and let us know if there's anything specific to this ERP version we should be aware of? Would like it live before the 20th if possible. Britta

subject: API errors right after new connector went live
body: Since the new ERP connector went live last week, our existing API integration (unrelated to that connector directly, as far as I can tell) has started throwing intermittent 500 errors on pulls that were working fine before. Not sure if the two are connected on your end, but the timing is suspicious. We're mid-close right now so a quick look would help. We had a brief look at Dashlume last year during a vendor refresh and nothing came of it then, but this kind of knock-on effect is the sort of thing that would bring it back into the conversation. Sigrid

subject: Third issue this month — alert firing on stale connector data
body: Following the connector setup and the API errors Sigrid raised, we've now had an alert fire based on what turned out to be stale data from the new connector rather than a genuine threshold breach, which caused a bit of unnecessary alarm internally. Three issues in the same fortnight, all touching the same new connector, isn't a great start to using it. We'll hold off adding any further data sources through it for now and stick to manual checks until we're more confident. Not urgent, but wanted the pattern on record. Britta

subject: Report builder question over the holidays
body: Small question while things are quiet - can report builder templates be shared across the whole team, or only within one user's account?

subject: Seat renewal timing question
body: Our seat renewal date is coming up in January - want to confirm whether we can adjust the seat count at renewal or if that's locked until the following cycle.

subject: Report builder template sharing - following up
body: Coming back to the template sharing question from December - a colleague had been pointing to Dashlume as an alternative that does this out of the box, but the shared template option you added recently covers what we needed. Just confirming the setup steps.

subject: Dashboards frozen since 9am
body: Our finance dashboard won't load, just spinning. Team's blocked for the Monday report. Need this fixed today, not eventually.

subject: Nightly API pull failing (500s)
body: The nightly API sync has thrown 500 errors three nights running. Our warehouse load is stalled. Can someone actually look at this today?

subject: Dashboard still down
body: Following up from yesterday. Dashboard is still not loading properly for half the team. Second day now.

subject: Export files coming back empty
body: CSV exports have been downloading as empty files since Monday. Same week as the API errors, feels like everything's falling over at once.

subject: Alerts not firing
body: Threshold alerts on the ops dashboard haven't fired since Friday even though the numbers clearly crossed the line. We rely on these.

subject: Alerts silent, confirming

subject: Dashboard tiles blank

subject: Export job stuck
body: Scheduled export hasn't completed in two days. Queue just shows processing. This is blocking month-end.

subject: Exports failing, again
body: Same export problem Anna just flagged, nothing's coming through. We need month-end numbers out today.

body: Report builder throws an error every time I try to save changes to the monthly template. Started right after the API issue was resolved, please tell me these are unrelated.

subject: Dashboard loading issue, back

subject: API 500s, third time
body: API throwing 500s again. This is becoming a pattern rather than an incident.

subject: API still broken this morning
body: Anna's ticket from yesterday, still not fixed on our side this morning. Please prioritise.

body: Third day of API instability. We need a root cause, not another quick patch.

subject: Alerts not triggering

subject: Connector sync delay

body: The same Salesforce connector paused overnight with no error message visible. Had to manually restart it this morning.

subject: Bulk seat import for new hires

Is there a CSV import option for provisioning users, or a way to at least pre-set their role/permissions template before they receive their invite? Would save us a fair bit of manual setup. Anna

subject: Dashboard filters not carrying over on share
body: When I apply a filter to a dashboard and then share the link with a colleague, they see the unfiltered version rather than the filtered view I intended, forcing them to reapply it themselves or ask me for a screenshot instead. For now I've just been exporting the filtered view to Excel and sending that directly, which works but defeats the point of sharing a live dashboard. Could this be looked at? Anna

subject: Still exporting to Excel instead of sharing dashboards
body: Following up on the filter-sharing issue from May — it's still behaving the same way, filtered views not carrying over on shared links, so we've just continued with the Excel export workaround in the meantime. It does the job for now, so there's no need to treat this as pressing, but wanted to note that the fix from a couple of months ago doesn't seem to have taken hold. Anna

body:

Can I nest groups, or is it flat group membership only? Also, if a user is in two groups with conflicting permissions, which takes precedence?

subject: Dashboard sharing with external clients

subject: Dashboard performance - noticeably faster

subject: Report builder - new grouping options great
body: The new grouping options in report builder are exactly what we asked for a while back. Nice to see it shipped.

body: Loving the new grouping feature, one small tweak request: could subtotal rows be bold by default? Minor, but would save us formatting each time.

subject: Setting up access structure for large team
body:
We are configuring the platform for a team of approximately 80 users across four departments. Looking for guidance on the recommended approach: is it better to use role-based access with department-specific roles, or to rely on sharing at the dashboard and report level? We want to avoid over-permissioning but also don't want to create an admin burden.

Ville Mäkinen
IT Manager

subject: Initial connector setup — multiple sources failing
body:
Setting up data connectors for the first time. Out of five sources I am trying to connect, three are failing at the authentication step. The two that work are our SQL Server instances. The three failing are Salesforce, Google BigQuery, and a REST API connector. For each I have verified the credentials are correct. Is there any known setup issue with these connector types that I should check?

Nils Larsson
Data Engineer

subject: Dashboard rendering inconsistent across users
body:
We have now onboarded around 50 of our 80 planned users. I am seeing reports from multiple users of dashboards not loading or loading with stale data. The issues are not consistent — the same dashboard loads fine for some users and not for others at the same time. Could this be a regional caching issue? Our users are split across three office locations.

Ville Mäkinen

subject: Report builder broken — cannot open any report
body:
Report builder is completely broken this morning. Clicking on any report just shows a blank screen. Not loading, just blank. This is affecting the whole team. What happened?

Nils Larsson

subject: Export queue backed up — jobs waiting hours
body:
We have four export jobs that have been sitting in the queue for over three hours. Normally they run within minutes. This is the second time in a week the export queue has seized up. Our finance team is waiting on this data for their monthly close. Is there a known capacity issue with the export infrastructure?

Ville Mäkinen

subject: Alerts module — bulk configuration broken
body:
Trying to update alert thresholds across 12 alerts using the bulk edit feature. The UI accepts the changes and shows a success message but none of the thresholds are actually updated when I check individually. Have to do it one by one as a workaround. The bulk edit feature is essentially non-functional.

Nils Larsson

subject: API degraded — failures across all endpoints
body:
We are seeing widespread API failures starting this morning. Approximately 30% of calls are returning 503 errors across multiple endpoints. Our data pipeline runs on this API and is currently producing incomplete output. This is the third significant reliability issue in the past month.

I want to be clear: we are an Enterprise customer and this level of instability is not acceptable. If this continues, the business case for staying on this platform becomes very hard to defend internally. Please escalate to engineering immediately and provide a timeline for resolution.

Ville Mäkinen
IT Manager

subject: Report builder performance unacceptable for complex reports
body:
Reports with more than about 10 calculated fields now take 3-5 minutes to render. This was not the case three months ago. We have not changed the reports. Whatever was deployed in the last quarter has significantly degraded performance for complex report builder configurations. This is affecting daily work for at least 15 of our users.

Nils Larsson

subject: Dashboard module broken for two weeks — still no fix
body:
We have been dealing with intermittent dashboard failures since early September. Some dashboards load, some don't. There is no pattern we can identify. We have 60+ active users who depend on these dashboards daily and we are fielding complaints constantly.

I have now raised this through three separate tickets. The responses have been helpful in tone but none of the suggested fixes have worked. I would like a direct call with someone from the engineering team, not another set of troubleshooting steps to try.

Ville Mäkinen
IT Manager

subject: API instability continuing — logging all failures
body:
Following up on the API issues from May and the ongoing platform instability. We are still seeing elevated error rates on the API. I have started logging every failure with timestamps and error codes — attaching the log to this ticket. There is no point escalating with urgency anymore; we are just documenting at this stage.

Nils Larsson

subject: Report builder performance — still degraded
body:
The report builder performance issue first raised in July has not improved. Complex reports still take several minutes to render. We have largely stopped building new complex reports and are working around the limitation where we can. Noting this for the record.

Ville Mäkinen
